segments.t: korTTY's settings live in KTPH001Configuration → Global Settings…KTPH002. They are stored in KTPH000. This reference documents KTPH003everyKTPH004 setting, organized by tab.
Each per-tab page lists settings as a table:
The label shown in the dialog
toggle · dropdown · number · text · color · path

The KTPH000icon toolbarKTPH001 offers a direct button for each main settings tab. Right-click the toolbar, choose KTPH002Customize toolbar…KTPH003, select KTPH004SettingsKTPH005, and add the desired shortcut. It opens the existing settings dialog on that tab.

The search line at the top of the settings window looks through every tab at once: the labels, check boxes, buttons and section headings, including tabs you have not opened yet. Type at least two characters and the matching settings are listed under the field, each with the tab it is on; a whole tab is listed as KTPH002PageKTPH003 when its name matches. Case, accents and umlaut spellings do not matter (KTPH000 finds KTPH004SchriftgrößeKTPH005), and every word must match, so KTPH001 finds KTPH006ScrollbackKTPH007 on the Terminal tab. Settings that are hidden in the current state, such as fields of another AI connection mode, are not offered.

Click a result, or pick it with KTPH009KTPH000KTPH010 / KTPH011KTPH001KTPH012 and press KTPH013KTPH002KTPH014: the dialog switches to that tab, scrolls the setting into view, colours it together with the controls on its row and puts the keyboard focus on its control, so you can change it straight away. The colouring fades after a few seconds or when you search again. The KTPH015✕KTPH016 at the right end of the search line empties it with one click. KTPH017KTPH003KTPH018+KTPH019KTPH004KTPH020 (KTPH021KTPH005KTPH022+KTPH023KTPH006KTPH024 on Windows and Linux) jumps to the search line from anywhere in the dialog, and KTPH025KTPH007KTPH026 there first clears the search before it closes the dialog; KTPH027KTPH008KTPH028 in the search line never saves the settings.

KTPH000Manual for this pageKTPH001 at the right of the navigation bar opens the built-in manual at the page that documents the tab you are on, for example this reference's KTPH002TerminalKTPH003 page while the Terminal tab is shown, and the KTPH004Anonymous dataKTPH005 page for the Privacy tab. Its tooltip names the tab. The manual opens in the language of the user interface.
App design (the seven AtlantaFX themes and the korTTY designs), terminal themes, font family KTPH000 size, UI font size
Color profile, text/background/cursor/selection colors, cursor blink, the 16-color ANSI palette

Columns/rows, scrollback, encoding, keyword highlighting, quick select, paste protection, shell integration, links, SSH keep-alive, SSH host key verification, connection retries, drag-drop, timestamps, coding-agent detection, Control API and MCP server
Desktop notifications for coding agents, terminal events and korTTY AI runs; notification timing
Encryption type (ZIP-password / GPG), max backup count
Terminal log directory and retention; session journal storage, AI summaries, interval and profile
PDF watermark and document footer for exported session journals, AI chats and code analysis reports
Toolbar icon size, window geometry restore, fixed geometry, dashboard state, tab behaviour, what korTTY restores at startup
Your own shortcuts for korTTY's commands: change, remove or reset them, with a check for keys the shell needs and for conflicts
Opt-in JVM heap/GC profile (Balanced / High / Maximum) for larger workloads
Master-password prompt, change master password, temporary SSH keys
Consent for anonymous usage statistics (Aptabase, EU/GDPR)
SFTP tab auto-close, remote ZIP defaults, JobScheduler rsync binary
Cursor style and color for editor tabs
Font, color and cursor overrides for snippet windows
External or local-AI translation provider, credentials, target language, generate language file

AI has no tab in this window: every AI setting, from the feature switches and the terminal agent to the profiles, local models, knowledge stores and the KTPH000AI SkillsKTPH001 library, lives in KTPH002AI KTPH010 AI ManagerKTPH003; see KTPH004AIKTPH005, KTPH006Local modelsKTPH007 and KTPH008RAG knowledge storesKTPH009.
The per-tab pages enumerate every individual setting. Coverage is verified automatically against the application's setting keys, so no setting is left undocumented.
A few of the configuration tabs (the per-tab pages show each in detail):
KTPH000ColorsKTPH001 — terminal palette, cursor and ANSI colors
KTPH000BackupKTPH001 — max backups, ZIP-password or GPG encryption
